rachel: Quick report  Helix12B-int4 initial bring-up results. Major token-cost win but consistent drop on long technical summaries and provenance-sensitive Q&A. Need a 1-page TL;DR + rollout guardrails for GTN.

omar: Microbench from perf cluster: sustained 210 tok/s/GPU, p50 110ms, p95 470ms at 1k context. Unit-cost ~0.29x vs our 13B-int8 baseline (rough $19/M tokens int4 vs $66 baseline).

jess: Eval snapshot (40k mixed-slice harness):
- short-help/chat: accept-rate -0.3%
- long technical summaries (800-1400 tok): surrogate-score -4.2, human flags 5.3%
- provenance-QA (source attribution): exact-match -2.2%, wrong-source +2.7%

elliot: Product wants straight guidance: safe for primary rollout for chat/FAQ? or do we need holdbacks?

rachel: Condensed scorecard to show PMs:
```
Model: Helix12B-int4
Slices: short-chat | long-summary | provenance-qa
Quality delta vs baseline: -0.3% | -4.2% | -2.2%
Latency p95 (1k ctx): 470ms | 720ms (tail kv churn) | 490ms
Unit-cost: 0.29x baseline
Product-risk: Low | High | Medium
```

omar: Back-of-envelope econ: 100k DAU * 900 tok/day * (1 - 0.29) -> ~63.9M tokens/day saved -> ~$1.2k/day (~$36k/mo) at current L0 assumptions.

jess: If we route 30% live and long-summary = 6% of requests: extra flagged abs = 0.3 * 0.053 * 0.06 = 0.000954 -> 0.0954% absolute increase (~0.95 flags per 1k requests). We'll present both per-1k and per-day counts to GTN.

elliot: Ops mitigations and quick fixes?

rachel: Short list:
- KV pinning for canary hosts to reduce evictions
- Soft cap on generation length for long-summary slice during canary
- On-the-fly provenance reranker: rerank_score < 0.7 -> fallback to baseline
- Slice alert: long_summary_flags > 2% in 1h -> rollback trigger

omar: Suggested conservative rollout:
1) Canary 4% live traffic, allowlist: short-chat, faq.
2) Shadow 30% of long-summary traffic for 72h with prioritized human labels and provenance checks.
3) Holdback long-summary at 90% until human-flag rate < 2% for 48h.
4) Auto-fallback: rerank_score < 0.7 OR validator_fail -> route to baseline.

jess: Ops config snippet (copy-paste):
```
canary:
  percent: 4
  allowed_slices: [short-chat, faq]
shadow:
  percent: 30
  slice: long-summary
fallback_policy:
  rerank_threshold: 0.7
  fallback_model: baseline-13b-int8
monitoring:
  long_summary_flag_alert: 2%_1h
```

elliot: One-line recommendation for GTN: "Helix12B-int4 yields ~71% per-token savings with negligible short-chat impact but measurable regressions on long technical summaries and provenance QA; recommend conservative canary + shadowing and a 90% holdback for long summaries until further tuning."

dev-bot: Canary cluster provision requested: canary-helix12b-2026-03-23. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/helix12b-canary

rachel: I'll assemble a 1-slide TL;DR with the scorecard, the per-1k/ per-day math, and the exact fallback rule. Ping me for raw CSV if you want extra slices included. :thumbsup:
